name: week
title: Monitoring week
subtitle: Fictional demo data until you import your own results

sections.title: Breached or due now
sections.note: Rule findings with the rule cited. docs/compliance.md has the source for each.
sections.sql: select rule,reference,finding from compliance_findings where severity=1 order by rule,reference

sections.title: Exceedances in the last 30 days
sections.sql: select site,location,sampled_on,analyte,value,unit,set_code as criterion,concat_ws(' to ',limit_low,limit_high) as limit_value,limit_unit,coalesce(action,'') as action from exceedances where sampled_on>=current_date-30 order by set_kind desc,sampled_on desc

sections.title: Rounds due in the next 14 days
sections.sql: select site,location,suite,next_due,days_overdue,consent from monitoring_due where next_due<=current_date+14 order by next_due

sections.title: Rising
sections.note: Latest result at least 50% above the mean of the results before it.
sections.sql: select site,location,analyte,latest,previous_mean,change_pct from analyte_trend where change_pct>=50 order by change_pct desc

name: qa
title: Data quality
subtitle: Duplicates, blanks, holding times, LORs and results still at the lab

sections.title: Field duplicates
sections.sql: select site,duplicate,parent,analyte,parent_value,duplicate_value,unit,rpd_pct,limit_pct from duplicate_rpd order by rpd_pct desc

sections.title: Every QA finding
sections.sql: select rule,reference,finding from compliance_findings where rule like 'POLICY-%' order by rule,reference

name: consents
title: Consents and licences
subtitle: Reports, renewals and exceedances by consent

sections.title: Consents
sections.sql: select ref,site,kind,regulator,report_due,days_to_report,expires_on,lodge_renewal_by,renewal_lodged_on,exceedances_12m,not_actioned from consent_status order by report_due

sections.title: Monitoring the consents require
sections.sql: select consent,site,location,suite,every_days,last_sampled,next_due,days_overdue from monitoring_due where consent is not null order by consent,location
